howto: Tap an empty pot to plant, tap a growing plant to water it (double speed), and tap a ripe pepper to harvest. Swipe across a row to do the whole row.
The big button always does the next useful thing: HARVEST, PLANT ALL, WATER ALL or SELL ALL.
Spend your cash on seeds, crew, upgrades, land and new businesses. Your crew keeps the farm earning while you are away.
tips: Walk-in buyers pay 1.3 to 1.7x market price, so keep a little stock on the shelf for them.
Water right after planting: watered plants grow twice as fast.
Ripe peppers left too long wilt and give half the yield.
Hire a Farmhand early: the crew plants and harvests for you, even while you are away.
The quest chip under the money always shows your next goal and its reward.
Too loud? The gear button has separate Music and Effects volume sliders.

controls.keyboard: Click pots or drag across a row. 1 to 9 pick a strain, Space presses the big button, ← → change rooms, Esc closes a panel, P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap pots or swipe across a row; the big button and the dock sit at the bottom. Pause is the fourth round button at the top.

difficulty: No difficulty modes: it is an idle farm that paces itself. Costs and prices climb with each strain, room and business, the story missions set the next goal, and the 1x / 2x / 4x button sets the pace.

cheats.effect: Every growing plant ripens right now
Every chili strain unlocked (this session only)

features.offline-earnings: WELCOME BACK card with the cash your crew made while you were away, and a COLLECT button
features.upgrade-tree: Upgrades and R&D in the lab, Crew hiring and training, new rooms of land, and four Empire businesses (jerky, streetwear, chili-salt mine, TV network)
features.big-number-format: Money reads $12.5K, $3.40M and $1.20B in the HUD and panels
features.prestige-or-next-goal: The quest chip always shows the next story mission and its reward; finishing the story unlocks the Legacy bonus (+10% prices, +15% yield)
features.results: Level-up, trophy, new-business and WELCOME BACK celebration cards; Trophies > Ledger keeps the farm's totals
features.tutorial: First play: Tito coaches plant, water, harvest and sell, each after you do the last one. How to play > Replay tutorial runs the walkthrough again on your current farm
features.hints: Hint in the pause menu names the most useful move right now (harvest, storage full, empty pots, thirsty plants, stock to sell) or the next goal
features.sound: Recorded music (a laid-back theme, and a faster rush track that crossfades in when the shop is busy), Tito Scorch's voice lines at key moments (at most one every 25 s, always shown in his speech bubble too) and recorded water, pluck, register and door-bell effects. Settings (gear) has Beat and Sound effects on/off plus separate Music and Effects volume sliders, saved on this device
